offline_replay.note: Captured-state replay only. It does not independently re-render the upstream terrain pass.

isolation_harness.defect: In --only-event --seed-marked, a synthetic black clear was encoded into the uncommitted frame command buffer, the authentic pre-image was uploaded in a separately committed blit, and the frame command buffer (carrying the clear) was committed afterwards. GPU order was upload -> clear -> draw, destroying the authentic pre-image.
isolation_harness.fix: Attachments are initialized and drained first, the authentic pre-image is uploaded and its transfer status checked, the pre-draw image is captured for verification, and only then is the selected draw encoded. Color is never cleared after a valid pre-image. Synthetic black remains only for the no-pre-image diagnostic. Depth is inspected: irrelevant for GL_NEVER/GL_ALWAYS or disabled tests; otherwise depth is cleared and marked unverified, or replayed from the recorded prefix when --depth-from-prefix is requested.
isolation_harness.regression: tests/test_m6_frame.py::IsolationOrderingTests.test_pre_image_survives_the_selected_draw (verified to fail under the old route ordering and pass after the fix)

selected_events.interpretation: The authentic pre-image is reproduced exactly and both sides change 73 pixels; the post-image differs on 18 pixels by at most one channel step.

A substantive terrain-producing draw (2177 changed pixels) with an exact pre-image and a near-identical post-image (685 pixels, max 8/255). The residual is consistent with compressed-texture/lighting rounding, not a contract failure. This qualifies this draw only, not the whole terrain pipeline.

terrain_pre_post.note: The earlier evidence that event 20 was an all-black candidate is superseded by the harness ordering correction.

replay_scope.finding: Patching the terrain draw's UNIFORM0[0].x (view-projection) by +0.5 in a copied trace produced ZERO differing pixels, while patching the composite's first uniform changed 763,491 pixels. The offline replay therefore re-renders the captured seed composite against captured textures; it does not re-render the terrain pass from its recorded inputs.
replay_scope.consequence: The pixel-exact offline result qualifies a captured-state replay, not an independent reconstruction of the terrain draw. Live terrain differences cannot be excluded or explained by the offline replay; they must be compared against the captured draw's inputs directly.

live_verification.remaining: The map remains beige despite an equivalent settled composition, matching per-draw vertex/texture/uniform/state inputs, the authentic shader variant and a faithful resolve. The remaining divergence is not yet identified.

live_start_policy.reason: One post-fix live verification was run; visual_match is false. Per the task rules the run was not repeated blindly and no qualification starts were claimed.

root_cause_history.finding: The original isolated terrain failure (all-black candidate) was caused by the harness pre-image/clear ordering defect.
root_cause_history.evidence: event 20 and 92 pre-images now match exactly

root_cause_history.finding: Offscreen render targets were viewport-scaled by the backbuffer HiDPI ratio (864x558 rendered into a 432x279 corner).
root_cause_history.evidence: live sample-u1 coverage was exactly 25% before the fix and 100% after; regression test added

root_cause_history.finding: Mipmapped textures used no mipmap live because the engine's base min and mip fields were conflated.
root_cause_history.evidence: live sampler trace min=0x2601/mip=0x2701 for every unit; captured min=0x2701 exactly for textures with >1 level; regression added

root_cause_history.finding: The MainScene resolve was claimed to read a previous composite.
root_cause_history.evidence: the frame-start clear is valid and targets the same texture; the first resolve source is the current terrain batch

root_cause_history.finding: The live and reference frames do not share the same map update composition (231/9 vs 252/6 draw calls), stably across uptime.
root_cause_history.evidence: caller-level order trace; single-draw inputs and output match; resolve status scaled_ok

root_cause_history.finding: The remaining live palette divergence is a frame/reference alignment issue, not a demonstrated renderer defect.
root_cause_history.evidence: same 231/9 composition at 280 s and 320 s; first resolve source is the beige current batch; resolve and single-draw contracts match

root_cause_history.finding: The live engine compiled the NO_SHADER_TEXTURE_LOD fallback because GLEW_ARB_shader_texture_lod was reported absent.
root_cause_history.evidence: master+0x18e was 0; fixed to 1; 78 live sources now carry the extension; regression added

root_cause_history.finding: The 231/9 versus 252/6 draw difference was a partially loaded frame/capture boundary, not missing/repeated operations.
root_cause_history.evidence: settled frame has 252 terrain and 12 map-layer calls = 6 default + 6 offscreen; caller/count order matches the captured terrain order

sampler_effective_state.defect: The engine sampler object stores base min=0x2601 and mip=0x2701 separately. The live encoder used the base min and disabled mipmapping for every texture, while GL uses GL_LINEAR_MIPMAP_NEAREST for textures with >1 mip level (captured min 0x2701) and GL_LINEAR for single-level textures.
sampler_effective_state.fix: eu4_gfx_effective_min_filter(state, has_mip_levels) selects the engine's mip filter when the bound texture has mip levels and the base min otherwise. sampler_for_unit uses it.

resolve_sequence.conclusion: No invalid resolve or copy was observed. The beige MainScene is the faithful copy of a beige current backbuffer produced by the terrain batch. The batch composition differs from the reference frame, so the pixel comparison is not aligned.

reference.note: batch after the fb0 clear, before composite

live_first_menu_frame.note: partially loaded frame; 3 of the 9 map-layer calls are offscreen/fb6

live_settled_frame.note: equivalent to the reference when the offscreen fb6 draws are excluded

frame_composition.conclusion: The 231/9 versus 252/6 difference was a capture-boundary/loading artifact, not missing or repeated live operations. A settle gate (252 terrain calls) now captures the fully loaded composition.

shader_capability.defect: The live backend reported master+0x18e (GLEW_ARB_shader_texture_lod) as 0, so the engine compiled the NO_SHADER_TEXTURE_LOD fallback for the terrain/map shaders: flat normals, no explicit-LOD path. The authentic GL context advertises the extension (captured driver source has '#extension GL_ARB_shader_texture_lod : enable').
shader_capability.fix: Report texture_lod=1 at master+0x18e, matching the authentic GL context. The live sources now carry the extension (78/78 in the settled run) and use the normal-map branch.
shader_capability.residual: The live map is still beige after this correction, so the fallback shader was a real but not sufficient divergence.
